title: tank
description: v0.1 device-model entity: a fluid reservoir monitored by a resistive level sensor. Published under renewvan/tank/<id>/<property>. Field additions since v0.1: alarm_state, temperature_c, last_inspected_date (v0.2); fill_rate_lpm, drain_rate_lpm, last_full_date, last_empty_date (v0.3); volume_since_full_l, volume_since_empty_l, level_pct_smoothed (v0.4), and last_inspected_date/last_full_date/last_empty_date renamed to last_inspected_at/last_full_at/last_empty_at with full ISO-8601 timestamps (v0.4, breaking); alarm_direction, alarm_threshold_pct, alarm_restore_pct (v0.5) -- retained/static identity fields, published once at startup alongside fluid_type/capacity_l, present under the same condition as alarm_state (a tank with alarm configured); level_pct_smoothed removed (v0.6, breaking, see docs/adr/0005); fill_rate_lpm, drain_rate_lpm removed (v0.7, breaking, see docs/adr/0006) -- unused instantaneous flow-rate fields, no consumer ever displayed them, superseded by volume_since_full_l/volume_since_empty_l for the dashboard's pace-based telemetry.

volume_since_full_l.description: Net liters moved since level_pct last committed a last_full_at latch. 0 if the tank has never latched full. Unconditional live field.

volume_since_empty_l.description: Net liters moved since level_pct last committed a last_empty_at latch. 0 if the tank has never latched empty. Unconditional live field.

alarm_state.description: Tank-level alarm state. Direction (low/high) is implicit in per-tank config. Present only if alarm_direction is configured for this tank.

alarm_direction.description: Which side of the threshold triggers alarm: 'low' alarms when level_pct drops to/below alarm_threshold_pct (e.g. fresh water), 'high' alarms when it rises to/above it (e.g. grey/black water). Retained/static, published once at startup (v0.5). Present only if alarm is configured for this tank -- same condition as alarm_state.

alarm_threshold_pct.description: level_pct value that trips alarm_state to 'alarm' (inclusive, per node-tank's hysteresis: low direction triggers at <=, high direction at >=). Retained/static, published once at startup (v0.5). Present only if alarm is configured for this tank.

alarm_restore_pct.description: level_pct value that clears alarm_state back to 'ok' (inclusive). The open band between alarm_threshold_pct and alarm_restore_pct is the caution zone. Retained/static, published once at startup (v0.5). Present only if alarm is configured for this tank.

temperature_c.description: Water temperature in degrees Celsius. Present only if an NTC temperature sensor is configured for this tank (10k thermistor divider on a spare ADS1115 channel, read by the tank node).

last_inspected_at.description: Most recent tank inspection, ISO-8601 timestamp with local UTC offset. Set via /set command topic (accepts a full timestamp or a bare YYYY-MM-DD date, normalized to local midnight); republished at startup only if previously set. Renamed from last_inspected_date (bare date) in v0.4.

last_full_at.description: Most recent auto-detected sustained full crossing (level_pct >= full_threshold_pct), ISO-8601 timestamp with local UTC offset. Also settable via /set command topic. Republished at startup only if previously latched. Renamed from last_full_date (bare date) in v0.4.

last_empty_at.description: Most recent auto-detected sustained empty crossing (level_pct <= empty_threshold_pct), ISO-8601 timestamp with local UTC offset. Also settable via /set command topic. Republished at startup only if previously latched. Renamed from last_empty_date (bare date) in v0.4.
